definitions.gloss: single color; monochrome; solid color; one color
definitions.explanation: Consisting of only one color, without patterns, gradients, or multiple hues.

examples.japanese: {単色|たんしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧Tシャツ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単色|たんしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁紙|かべがみ}→壁紙：16077_kabegami⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦まとめてある→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: This room is done in a single-color wallpaper throughout.

examples.japanese: {単色|たんしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧なら⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: If it's single-color printing, we can keep the costs down.

notes:
Composed of {単|たん} (single) + {色|しょく} (color). Used in fashion, design, printing, and art contexts. Can modify nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {単色|たんしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧ (monochrome design).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単色|たんしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧ — monochrome design
- {単色|たんしょく}⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧ — single-color printing
- {単色|たんしょく}{刷|ず}り — single-color print
- {単色|たんしょく}{光|こう} — monochromatic light

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦モノクロ→モノクロ：11226_monokuro⟧ — monochrome (loanword; often specifically means black and white)
- ⟦{無地|むじ}→無地：03990_muji⟧ — plain, unpatterned (focuses on absence of pattern rather than having one color)
- ⟦{多色|たしょく}→多色：26459_tashoku⟧ — multicolored (the opposite)
- {二色|にしょく} — two-colored, bicolor
